title: Lock signs together in block variants
summary: Builders can now lock all the signs in a block variant cell to one sign's settings.
highlights: Click the lock on a sign and every other sign in the cell copies its mount, facing, text, colour, glow and wax, keeping its own wood
While locked, a change to any of them reaches them all, and new signs added to the cell join in
Wax and text editing are now quick icon buttons at the top of the sign popup
